description: This file declares functions and types for manipulating and retrieving system time, including getting current time, calculating elapsed time, comparing times, and converting time to strings or timespec structures.

methods.name: rtTime_Now
methods.description: Retrieves the current system time and stores it in the provided rtTime_t structure.

methods.name: rtTime_Later
methods.description: Calculates a new time that is 'ms' milliseconds after the 'from' time, or current time if 'from' is NULL.

methods.name: rtTime_Elapsed
methods.description: Computes the number of milliseconds elapsed between 'start' and 'end' times.

methods.name: rtTime_Compare
methods.description: Compares two times, returning -1, 0, or 1 depending on their chronological order.

methods.name: rtTime_ToString
methods.description: Converts an rtTime_t to a human-readable string in HH:MM:SS.mmm format.

methods.name: rtTime_ToTimespec
methods.description: Converts an rtTime_t into a timespec structure suitable for functions like pthread_cond_timedwait.
